zoxide Advanced Configuration

Learn zoxide's advanced configuration options, including environment variables, custom aliases, directory exclusion, and more.

zoxide Advanced Configuration

Customize zoxide with env vars, aliases, and performance tweaks.

Environment Variables

Exclude directories

export _ZO_EXCLUDE_DIRS="/tmp:/var:/node_modules"

Separate multiple paths with colons.

Custom database location

export _ZO_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/zoxide"

Maximum history age

export _ZO_MAXAGE=5000

Exclusion patterns

export _ZO_EXCLUDE_PATHS=".git"

Alias Settings

alias zz='z'
alias zi='zi'
alias za='zoxide add'
alias zq='zoxide query'
alias zr='zoxide remove'

fzf Integration

# Add to ~/.zshrc
zi() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf) && z "$dir"
}

Performance Optimization

Reduce index scope

export _ZO_EXCLUDE_DIRS="/tmp:/var:/proc:/sys"

Periodic cleanup

ls -lh ~/.zo
rm ~/.zo

Team Collaboration

export _ZO_DATA_DIR="/shared/path/zoxide"

Summary

Start with exclusions, then fine-tune history and database location to fit your workflow. See the official docs for more options.
